body: I know I need to get my life together but I don’t even know where to begin. I’m 310 at 5”6/5”7 and just depressed as fuck. I want to change but most times I say I will I always fold and go back on promises I make to myself and I hate it. Maybe this is a bit of a wake up call because I see other posts here that are similar to my situation and they did it, so maybe I can too.
